technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with massive volume spike suggest capitulation, but absence of bullish confirmation signals, bearish price structure below all moving averages, and negative momentum indicators create high risk of further downside before any reversal.

fundamental.summary: EFX shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 19 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (31 Fear & Greed score) presents contrarian buying opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and unavailable news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (371.2) combined with earnings binary in 19 days creates severe near-term risk; normal yield curve offers limited offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9 and 14) combined with 15x volume spike and fear-zone sentiment (31 Fear & Greed) suggest capitulation-driven washout with potential mean-reversion bounce.
debate.key_bear_argument: Complete absence of bullish confirmation—price below all major moving averages, MACD bearish, Ichimoku below cloud, three black crows pattern, and RSI 14 failing to rise despite extreme oversold—indicates structural weakness likely to test support at 218.61 before any reversal.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI and 15x volume spike present contrarian appeal in fear-zone sentiment, but complete absence of bullish confirmation signals and structural weakness below all moving averages create unacceptable risk-reward at current price.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary in 19 days combined with VIX crisis regime (371.2) and price structure suggesting further downside to 218.61 support before any reversal attempt.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, and risk agents all signal weakness; only sentiment offers contrarian angle but insufficient to override structural bearishness
decision.portfolio_note: Already 26 positions in Industrials sector; adding EFX increases concentration risk without conviction catalyst.
